title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in iWorks Orphans…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in iWorks Orphans (sierotki) versions up to 3.4.6. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
